english.text: The spectacle presents itself simultaneously as society itself, as a part of society, and as a means of unification. As a part of society, it is the focal point of all vision and all consciousness. But due to the very fact that this sector is separate, it is in reality the domain of delusion and false consciousness: the unification it achieves is nothing but an official language of universal separation.

jyutping: ni1 go3 ging2 zoeng6 tung4 si4 cing4 jin6 wai4 se5 wui2 bun2 san1，zok3 wai4 se5 wui2 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6，tung4 maai4 zok3 wai4 tung2 jat1 ge3 sau2 dyun6，zok3 wai4 se5 wui2 ge3 jat1 bou6 fan6，keoi5 hai6 so2 jau5 jyun6 ging2 tung4 so2 jau5 ji3 sik1 ge3 ziu1 dim2 fan1 lei4，keoi5 sat6 zai3 soeng6 hai6 mong5 soeng2 tung4 gaa2 ji3 sik1 ge3 ling5 wik6：keoi5 so2 daat6 dou3 ge3 tung2 jat1 zi2 hai6 jat1 zung2 pou2 pin3 fan1 lei4 ge3 gun1 fong1 jyu5 jin4。
text: 呢個景象同時呈現為社會本身，作為社會嘅一部分，同埋作為統一嘅手段，作為社會嘅一部分，佢係所有願景同所有意識嘅焦點 分離，佢實際上係妄想同假意識嘅領域：佢所達到嘅統一只係一種普遍分離嘅官方語言。

english.text: Things went on much as before, but after a time I began to find that there was a bit of a change in Mary herself. She had always been so trusting and so innocent, but now she became queer and suspicious, wanting to know where I had been and what I had been doing, and whom my letters were from, and what I had in my pockets, and a thousand such follies.

jyutping: si6 cing4 hou2 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam2 gai3 zuk6，daan6 hai6 gwo3 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan1 ngo5 hoi1 ci2 faat3 jin6 maa5 lai6 bun2 san1 jau5 siu2 siu2 bin3 faa3。keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hai6 gam2 seon3 jam6 tung4 gam3 mou4 gu1，daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 keoi5 bin3 dak1 kei4 gwaai3 tung4 waai4 ji4，soeng2 zi1 ngo5 heoi3 gwo3 bin1 dou6 tung4 zou6 gwo3 di1 me1，tung4 maai4 ngo5 di1 seon3 hai6 lai4 zi6 bin1 go3，tung4 maai4 ngo5 doi6 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 me1，tung4 maai4 jat1 cin1 man4 ni1 di1 gam3 jyu4 ceon2 ge3 je5。
text: 事情好似以前噉繼續，但係過咗一段時間我開始發現瑪麗本身有少少變化。佢一向都係噉信任同咁無辜，但係而家佢變得奇怪同懷疑，想知我去過邊度同做過啲咩，同埋我啲信係嚟自邊個，同埋我袋入面有啲咩，同埋一千文呢啲咁愚蠢嘅嘢。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On my way to the pizzeria a second time today, the 27th of March of 2015, I encounter Moli the Fijian in her garden as she trims her bushes in the sculpted shape of penises. They remind me of that old movie Caligula. Her name in Fijian means orange. Her husband Leong, also Fijian, studied sinograms as a child, but has forgotten everything. To each other, Moli and Leong speak a brownish English.

jyutping: gam1 jat6，zik1 hai6 2015 nin4 3 jyut6 27 hou6，ngo5 dai6 ji6 ci3 heoi3 bok6 beng2 dim3 ge3 lou6 soeng6，ngo5 hai2 keoi5 go3 faa1 jyun2 dou6 jyu6 dou3 fei2 zai3 jan4 mok6 lei6，keoi5 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 gun3 muk6 sau1 zin2 sing4 jam1 ging3 ge3 diu1 haak1 jing4 zong6。keoi5 dei6 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2 go2 tou3 gau6 din6 jing2《kaa1 lei6 gu2 laai1》。keoi5 go3 meng2 hai2 fei2 zai3 man4 ge3 ji3 si1 hai6 caang2 sik1。keoi5 lou5 gung1 loeng4，jik6 dou1 hai6 fei2 zai3 jan4，sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hok6 gwo3 hon3 zi6 daan6 hai6 ji5 ging1 mong4 gei3 zo2 so2 jau5 je5。deoi3 jyu1 deoi3 fong1，mok6 lei6 tung4 loeng4 dou1 hai6 gong2 fe1 sik1 ge3 jing1 man2。
text: 今日，即係2015年3月27號，我第二次去薄餅店嘅路上，我喺佢個花園度遇到斐濟人莫利，佢將佢嘅灌木修剪成陰莖嘅雕刻形狀。佢哋令我諗起嗰套舊電影《卡利古拉》。佢個名喺斐濟文嘅意思係橙色。佢老公梁，亦都係斐濟人，細個嗰陣學過漢字但係已經忘記咗所有嘢。對於對方，莫利同梁都係講啡色嘅英文。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: At the night of the 28th of December of 2024, I was at Starbucks café, here on Lulu Island. Peter the redhead linguistics guru and I greeted each other "Happy New Year!" At home, cousin Eve's cousin Rex was relaxing in front of the kitchen television with Eve and Mama. Rex is visiting from the states. I offered them some shrimp crackers, which Rex gifted me earlier. In the fridge, Mama has a big load of lotus leaf-wrapped meat-stuffed sticky rice packs from their outing today. I was playing with Grok AI: I was thinking that AI could write me a story about Jack and the Beanstalk in Tagalog or Esperanto. A person named Jack is the cousin of Eve and Rex. He lives in the Philippines. On the kitchen television at home was showing a renowned Filipina singer singing before she had a sex-change operation to become a man. I told Rex that I read about such operations in the Biomedical Library in my university, UBC.

jyutping: hai2 2024 nin4 12 jyut6 28 hou6 ge3 je6 maan5，ngo5 hai2 sing1 baa1 hak1 gaa3 fe1 gun2，nei1 dou6 hai6 lou6 lou6 dou2。ngo5 tung4 hung4 faat3 jyu5 jin4 hok6 daai6 si1 Peter wu6 soeng1 man6 hau6「san1 nin4 faai3 lok6！」hai2 uk1 kei2，biu2 mui2 haa6 waa1 ge3 biu2 mui2 Rex tung4 haa6 waa1 tung4 maa4 maa1 hai2 cyu4 fong2 din6 si6 cin4 min6 fong3 sung1 gan2。Rex jau4 gok3 zau1 lai4 gan2。ngo5 bei2 zo2 di1 haa1 beng2 keoi5 dei6，ni1 di1 hai6 Rex zou2 paai4 sung3 bei2 ngo5 ge3。hai2 syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6，maa1 mi4 jau5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 gam1 jat6 ceot1 jau4 ge3 ho4 jip6 baau1 juk6 haam2 no6 mai5 baau1。ngo5 waan2 gan2 Grok AI ：ngo5 nam2 gan2 AI ho2 ji5 jung6 taap3 gaa1 lok3 man4 waak6 ze2 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 se2 jat1 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 git6 hak1 tung4 dau2 ging3 ge3 gu3 si6 bei2 ngo5 teng1。jau5 go3 giu3 Jack ge3 jan4 hai6 haa6 waa1 tung4 leoi4 hak1 si1 ge3 biu2 hing1 dai6。keoi5 zyu6 hai2 fei1 leot6 ban1。hai2 uk1 kei2 cyu4 fong2 din6 si6 dou6 bo3 gan2 jat1 go3 zyu3 ming4 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 go1 sau2 hai2 keoi5 zou6 zo2 bin3 sing3 sau2 seot6 zi1 cin4 coeng3 go1，sing4 wai4 zo2 naam4 jan2。ngo5 tung4 Rex gong2，ngo5 hai2 ngo5 gaan1 daai6 hok6 UBC ge3 sang1 mat6 ji1 hok6 tou4 syu1 gun2 tai2 gwo3 jau5 gwaan1 ne1 leoi6 sau2 seot6 ge3 zi1 liu2。
text: 喺2024年12月28號嘅夜晚，我喺星巴克咖啡館，呢度係露露島。我同紅髮語言學大師 Peter 互相問候「新年快樂！」喺屋企，表妹夏娃嘅表妹 Rex 同夏娃同媽媽喺廚房電視前面放鬆緊。Rex 由各州嚟緊。我畀咗啲蝦餅佢哋，呢啲係 Rex 早排送畀我嘅。喺雪櫃入面，媽咪有一大堆今日出遊嘅荷葉包肉餡糯米包。我玩緊 Grok AI ：我諗緊 AI 可以用塔加洛文或者世界語寫一個關於傑克同豆莖嘅故事畀我聽。有個叫 Jack 嘅人係夏娃同雷克斯嘅表兄弟。佢住喺菲律賓。喺屋企廚房電視度播緊一個著名嘅菲律賓歌手喺佢做咗變性手術之前唱歌，成為咗男人。我同 Rex 講，我喺我間大學 UBC 嘅生物醫學圖書館睇過有關呢類手術嘅資料。
